name: Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings, Incorporated
summary: Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings, Incorporated, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the generation, transmission, distribution, and retail of electric power in Japan and internationally. It generates power through nuclear, fuel, and thermal, as well as solar, geothermal, hydro, and offshore wind power plants; and engages in the procurement, transportation, and trading of fuel. The company is also involved in the gas supply business.
